targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicPlugin. Claim only task rg6-plugin-vector-availability-consumer-migration-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-5 ProjectContext anchored creation is accepted at AlembicPlugin commit f76d10efb781507ca394beb8a054f51b0ed75259. RG-6 Core producer is accepted at AlembicCore commit 9eec6303549c3678bc1b0910d5d7fd3b7d3b992f and provides the standard @alembic/core/vector availability surface, including VectorService.isAvailable()/getAvailability() and public availability types. Goal: complete the Plugin consumer side of RG-6 vector availability isolation by replacing Plugin-local availability derivation from getStats().embedProviderAvailable with the accepted Core availability interface, while preserving existing vector/search behavior and output compatibility. Required behavior: (1) inspect current Plugin vector readiness call sites first, especially lib/runtime/mcp/host-agent-workflows/recipe-region-vector.ts, lib/runtime/mcp/handlers/search.ts, lib/service/resident/AlembicResidentServiceClient.ts, lib/cli/SetupService.ts, and test/unit/VectorService.test.ts or equivalent tests that still mirror stats availability. (2) Migrate consumer readiness checks to Core VectorService.getAvailability()/isAvailable() or the accepted public availability type/facade; do not add a duplicate Plugin-only availability helper that reinterprets provider internals. (3) Preserve getStats() for counts/index/dimensions and backwards-compatible fields where outputs still need statistics, but no longer treat stats.embedProviderAvailable as the authoritative readiness gate. (4) Surface structured availability/degraded reason/status in user-facing or clean MCP outputs where RG-6 requires observable vector degradation, including stop-Ollama/unavailable-provider style paths if those outputs currently report vector readiness. (5) Keep four public MCP business semantics intact; changes should be additive/diagnostic except where they replace legacy readiness derivation. (6) Add tests covering available, unavailable, and degraded provider states through the Plugin consumer path; update legacy tests that assert stats-derived readiness; include clean-output/public-output contract coverage where fields change. Boundaries: do not edit AlembicCore except for a minimal compile/type import follow-up if the accepted public API is unusable; do not implement RG-7 create/evolve immediate source_refs/vector timing repair, RG-8 commit-driven unified evolution/rename/new-module routing, RG-9 cleanup, RG-10 BiliDili scenario, daemon/watch behavior, or deletion of evidence/proposal/vector structures. Do not change Plan authority or create Plugin-local Plan/generation state. If the consumer migration is too broad, return blocked/needs-review with the smallest safe split and raw call-site evidence. Expected validation: npm run build:check; targeted Plugin tests for migrated vector availability/search/resident/setup paths; any MCP clean-output/public contract tests touched by new availability fields; npm run lint; npm run lint:repo-boundary; npm run lint:layer-boundary; npm run lint:core-import-boundary; npm run verify:release-package-boundary; git diff --check; Alembic Guard over changed files. Return TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash, changed files, exact validation output, remaining risks, and next-step notes.
